dish: Classic red-sauce Italian-American — housemade pasta and a martini at the bar
w: On University Avenue since 1952 (City Cast's oldest-restaurants list); Best of Madison 2026 gold for Italian, silver for Chef (Andres Martinez) and bronze for Upscale Dining.

dish: Modern lagers, IPAs and mixed-fermentation sours
w: East-isthmus brewery (2018) with a serious mixed-fermentation program; UpNorthNews readers' #4 Madison brewery 2025 and bronze Brewery in Best of Madison 2026.

dish: Supper-club salad bar and prime rib
w: Waunakee supper club popular for special-occasion banquets (City Cast's supper-club guide); silver for Salad Bar in Best of Madison 2026.

dish: Full salad bar and prime-rib specials
w: McFarland supper club serving the full supper-club ritual for 40+ years (City Cast); gold for Salad Bar in Best of Madison 2026.

dish: The bar burger City Cast calls the best in town
w: Atwood neighborhood sports bar City Cast credits with Madison's best bar burgers; silver Sports Bar in Best of Madison 2026.

dish: Spotted Cow — sold only in Wisconsin — in the hilltop beer garden
w: The Swiss village's craft brewery, maker of Spotted Cow (Best of Madison 2026 gold for local craft beer, gold Brewery 2025 & 2026); Time Out names it the side-trip from Madison, and its Bavarian-style hilltop brewery has a self-guided tour and beer garden.

dish: Old-fashioned and apple-fritter donuts (Madison's only certified-kosher bakery)
w: Kosher donut bakery since 1996 — gold for Bakery–Sweets in Best of Madison 2025 and 2026, UpNorthNews readers' best bakery in southern Wisconsin, #26 on a 2025 national best-donut-shops list.

dish: Hot & spicy cheese bread, pulled warm at the Saturday farmers' market
address: Capitol Square (Dane County Farmers' Market), Madison, WI 53703
w: The farmers' market ritual: Stella's hot & spicy cheese bread, torn apart while circling the Capitol. Silver for Bakery–Bread in Best of Madison 2025 and 2026; UpNorthNews' bakery roundup.
Downtown brunch standby — gold for Breakfast/Brunch in Best of Madison 2026 (silver 2025), and on UpNorthNews' best-brunch roundup.
Neighborhood tavern on City Cast's best-fish-fry list and UpNorthNews' best-brunch roundup.

dish: A Driftless Glen brandy old fashioned on the Baraboo River patio; brandy-glazed salmon
w: Baraboo craft distillery with a riverfront restaurant whose menu is cooked with its own spirits; Best of Madison 2026 gold for Outdoor Dining and bronze for Old Fashioned and Bloody Mary, plus a 2025 Bar medal.

dish: Prime rib or a steak and a relish tray under Wright-protégé architecture
w: Supper club run by the Wimmer family since 1943, its stone-and-glass building designed by Taliesin-trained James Dresser in Wright's organic style; celebrated 80 years in 2023. Best of Madison 2026 silver for Destination Restaurant and Steakhouse, bronze for Supper Club.
